dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.text: Good morning, city student accommodation. How can I assist you today?

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.text: Hello, I am looking for a single en-suite room for the upcoming autumn semester starting in September.

question: What type of room is the student inquiring about?
audioText: Receptionist: Good morning, city student accommodation. How can I assist you today? Student: Hello, I am looking for a single en-suite room for the upcoming autumn semester starting in September. Question: What type of room is the student inquiring about?
translation:
안내원: 안녕하세요, 시티 학생 기숙사입니다. 오늘 무엇을 도와드릴까요?
학생: 안녕하세요, 9월에 시작하는 이번 가을 학기에 혼자 쓸 수 있는 화장실 딸린 싱글룸(en-suite)을 찾고 있습니다.
질문: 학생이 문의하고 있는 방의 유형은 무엇인가?
tip: 핵심 명사구 'single en-suite room'을 직접 청취하면 바로 답을 고를 수 있는 Section 1 전형적 문제입니다.

dialogue.speaker: Guide
dialogue.text: Now, turning to our university sports complex. Please note that while the gymnasium is open seven days a week, the Olympic swimming pool is currently closed for urgent maintenance.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.text: When is the pool expected to reopen to registered members?

dialogue.speaker: Guide
dialogue.text: Technicians estimate work will finish by next Thursday morning.

question: Which facility is temporarily unavailable to visitors?
audioText: Guide: Now, turning to our university sports complex. Please note that while the gymnasium is open seven days a week, the Olympic swimming pool is currently closed for urgent maintenance. Visitor: When is the pool expected to reopen to registered members? Guide: Technicians estimate work will finish by next Thursday morning. Question: Which facility is temporarily unavailable to visitors?
translation:
가이드: 이제 대학 스포츠 콤플렉스로 가보겠습니다. 체육관은 주 7일 운영되지만, 올림픽 규격 수영장은 현재 긴급 보수 공사로 문을 닫았으니 유의하시기 바랍니다.
방문객: 등록 회원들에게 수영장이 언제 다시 열릴 예정인가요?
가이드: 기사분들께서는 다음 주 목요일 아침까지 작업이 끝날 것으로 예상하고 있습니다.
질문: 방문객이 현재 일시적으로 이용할 수 없는 시설은 무엇인가?
tip: 'currently closed for urgent maintenance' 앞뒤의 주어 'Olympic swimming pool'을 포착하는 것이 정답 단서입니다.

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.text: Coral bleaching occurs predominantly when water temperatures rise beyond typical seasonal thresholds. Under prolonged thermal stress, corals expel the symbiotic algae inhabiting their tissues, causing them to turn completely white. Contrary to popular belief, bleached corals are not dead; however, their mortality rate increases substantially if environmental conditions do not normalize within several weeks.

question: What is the primary consequence when corals undergo severe bleaching?
options: They expel microscopic symbiotic algae from their tissue
They permanently lose their physical calcium structure
They instantaneously perish within twenty-four hours
They rapidly migrate to deeper marine trenches
answer: They expel microscopic symbiotic algae from their tissue
audioText: Professor: Coral bleaching occurs predominantly when water temperatures rise beyond typical seasonal thresholds. Under prolonged thermal stress, corals expel the symbiotic algae inhabiting their tissues, causing them to turn completely white. Contrary to popular belief, bleached corals are not dead; however, their mortality rate increases substantially if environmental conditions do not normalize within several weeks. Question: What is the primary consequence when corals undergo severe bleaching?
translation:
교수: 산호 백화 현상은 주로 수온이 일반적인 계절적 한계치를 초과하여 상승할 때 발생합니다. 장기간 열 스트레스를 받으면, 산호는 조직에 서식하는 공생 조류(algae)를 체외로 방출하여 완전히 하얗게 변합니다. 일반적인 믿음과 달리 백화된 산호가 곧바로 죽은 것은 아니지만, 몇 주 내에 환경 조건이 정상화되지 않으면 폐사율이 크게 증가합니다.
질문: 산호가 심각한 백화 현상을 겪을 때 나타나는 주요 결과는 무엇인가?
tip: 학술 강의 독백으로 'expel the symbiotic algae inhabiting their tissues'라는 과학적 인과 과정을 청취해야 합니다.

dialogue.speaker: Tutor
dialogue.text: Your literature review is comprehensive, David, but your data collection methodology relies too heavily on small qualitative surveys.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.text: Would you suggest conducting a broader quantitative questionnaire to reinforce empirical validity?

dialogue.speaker: Tutor
dialogue.text: Precisely. Incorporating at least two hundred respondents will render your statistical analysis significantly more robust.

question: What modification does the tutor recommend for David's dissertation?
options: Expanding the sample size via quantitative questionnaires
Rewriting the theoretical literature review section
Changing the research topic entirely before submission
Omitting statistical modeling from the final paper
answer: Expanding the sample size via quantitative questionnaires
audioText: Tutor: Your literature review is comprehensive, David, but your data collection methodology relies too heavily on small qualitative surveys. David: Would you suggest conducting a broader quantitative questionnaire to reinforce empirical validity? Tutor: Precisely. Incorporating at least two hundred respondents will render your statistical analysis significantly more robust. Question: What modification does the tutor recommend for David's dissertation?
translation:
지도교수: 데이비드, 문헌 고찰은 매우 포괄적이지만, 데이터 수집 방법론이 소규모 정성 설문조사에 너무 크게 의존하고 있네.
데이비드: 실증적 타당성을 강화하기 위해 더 광범위한 정량적 설문지를 진행하는 것이 좋을까요?
지도교수: 정확해. 최소 200명의 응답자를 확보하면 통계 분석이 훨씬 더 견고해질 걸세.
질문: 지도교수는 데이비드의 논문에 어떤 수정을 권고하는가?
tip: 'broader quantitative questionnaire'와 'incorporating at least two hundred respondents'를 통한 표본 확대 권고를 파악합니다.

dialogue.speaker: Librarian
dialogue.text: To activate your digital university library card, we need to verify your proof of address. A utility bill or tenancy agreement will suffice.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.text: I have brought my official tenancy contract right here in my folder.

question: Which document has the student brought to verify his address?
audioText: Librarian: To activate your digital university library card, we need to verify your proof of address. A utility bill or tenancy agreement will suffice. Student: I have brought my official tenancy contract right here in my folder. Question: Which document has the student brought to verify his address?
translation:
사서: 디지털 대학 도서관 카드를 활성화하려면 주소 증명 서류를 확인해야 합니다. 공과금 청구서나 임대 계약서면 충분합니다.
학생: 제 서류철에 공식 임대 계약서(tenancy contract)를 바로 챙겨왔습니다.
질문: 학생이 주소를 확인하기 위해 가져온 서류는 무엇인가?
tip: 'tenancy agreement'의 동의 표현인 'tenancy contract'를 찾아내는 직관적인 문제입니다.
